subject: pangolin
title: Lions Batted a Pangolin Around for an Hour. It Walked Away

scenes.text: A pride of lions couldn't open this animal.
Near Kruger Park in 2025, young lions found a pangolin and attacked.
It rolled into a tight ball of overlapping scales.
For almost an hour they bit it, batted it and rolled it around.
Those scales are keratin, like your fingernails, and make up about a fifth of its weight.
The lions gave up. The pangolin unrolled and walked away unharmed.

description:
In February 2025, young lions of a 20-strong pride on a private reserve in Greater Kruger spent almost an hour mauling a rolled-up pangolin, then gave up; it walked off unharmed. A similar encounter was filmed in Kenya's Masai Mara.
Pangolin scales are made of keratin and make up about 20% of their weight.
Who would you bet on next time?
first_comment: Lions don't always lose this fight, but they often do. What other animal could survive a whole pride?
